title: The Turkish Oropharyngeal Dysphagia Screening Test for Patients and Professionals
brief_summary: The purpose of this study is to test the reliability and validity of the The Turkish Oropharyngeal Dysphagia Screening Test for Patients and Professionals among adult patients with swallowing disorders.
raw_criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* Willing to participate
* Having swallowing problems

Exclusion Criteria:

* Being under the age of 20 years, and above the age of 60 years
* Not willing to participate
* No swallowing problems
